title: Bessent's Yen Dare, Modi's Global Payments Ambition
description:
Insight with Haslinda Amin, a daily news program featuring in-depth, high-profile interviews and analysis to give viewers the complete picture on the stories that matter. The show features prominent leaders spanning the worlds of business, finance, politics and culture.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - Insight with Haslinda Amin Begins
00:02:14 - US says it destroyed Iranian tankers after US Navy ship targeted 
00:06:34 - Brent oil pushes toward $100 after US attacks Iranian tankers
00:11:03 - RBC Wealth Management Asia senior investment strategist Jasmine Duan on the yen’s recovery
00:18:18 - Bessent dares traders to bet against yen: ‘I am the house now’
00:18:59 - Ex-BOK governor addresses yen intervention and Korea's FX market
00:24:10 - Former US Trade Representative Susan Schwab on US-Canada trade tensions (11C) Modi courts diaspora to expand ubiquitous payment system abroad
00:27:49 - Modi courts diaspora to expand ubiquitous payment system abroad
00:28:49 - Visa India & South Asia Group country manager Suresh Sethi on India’s digital payments opportunity
00:38:14 - NSE cuts IPO price range, giving up shot at India’s top listing (11D) BSE CEO Sundararaman Ramamurthy on the NSE IPO plans
00:40:00 - BSE CEO Sundararaman Ramamurthy on the NSE IPO plans
